summary: Read the eight pages whole (The Lens and D3.js in the relevant parts) and checked each target for any sentence naming the source. Pattern: nearly all the bare links are real relations whose reason sits in one page's body (the roster on Philosopher Visits, the Stoicism paragraph on Palace Philosophies, the three-deck and body-schema passages), so 35 take a label, 2 retype (Deleuze to Spinoza as deepens, Merleau-Ponty to Stoicism as contradicts), and 1 is cut (Palace Philosophies to 1 from 2: neither page names the other). Targets rarely name the source back, so most evidence is one-sided. Could not settle: the Fire at Nicopolis is a Dialectic on the Dialectic page but an Excellent Adventure on Fortress and Stoicism; both STIGMERGY v1.0 targets resolve into STIGMERGY/Archive/, which Loudon may want to re-aim; D3.js holds bare duplicate links to Matplotlib, Observable Plot and p5.js, and Deleuze holds a bare duplicate to STIGMERGY Philosophical Lenses, all outside my list. One newcomer inbound proposed (Palace Philosophies to CHILD); no other under-reached entry was named on a page I read.
